messages.subject: [pomp-announce] pomp version 0.40-1 released
messages.body_plain:
Dear pomp users,

I've just submitted version pomp 0.40-1 to CRAN.  Source code and binaries 
should become available on the mirrors over the next few days.  There are 
several new features available in this version of pomp.  

The highlights are increased flexibility for discrete-time models.  In 
particular, it is now possible for discrete time deterministic skeletons to 
have a general time-step size, as has been the case for discrete-time 
stochastic process models for some time.  In addition, accumulator variables 
are now handled in a uniform way for both the 'rprocess' and 'skeleton' 
portions of a model.

See the package NEWS file for more details on this and other changes.

All the best,

Aaron

-- 
Aaron A. King, Ph.D.
Ecology & Evolutionary Biology
Mathematics
Center for the Study of Complex Systems
University of Michigan
